jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps & Laravel Developer - Remote EMEA
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: EMEA

We're seeking a passionate and inventive Senior Laravel/DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role is not just about writing code; it's about fueling collaboration and pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the web. Your expertise in Laravel paired with your prowess in AWS infrastructure will be instrumental in architecting robust, scalable solutions that empower teams to create and collaborate with efficiency and ease.

In this role, you will be responsible for:
• Lead DevOps Initiatives: Take charge of our AWS infrastructure. You'll optimize, automate, and maintain our systems, ensuring high availability and top-notch performance. Your role is pivotal in creating a seamless bridge between development and operations.
• Architect Solutions: Design and implement robust services and APIs, ensuring they are efficient, secure, and scalable. You'll be the architect, laying the foundations upon which transformative... features are built.
• Develop & Innovate: Craft high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code using Laravel. Your work will directly contribute to the core of our products, influencing how teams collaborate worldwide.
• Collaborate & Inspire: Work closely with cross-functional teams, contributing ideas and insights. Your role extends beyond code; it's about inspiring innovation and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
• Problem-Solve & Optimize: Tackle complex challenges, optimize existing processes, and introduce innovations that elevate the performance, reliability, and usability of our products.
• Set Standards: Take a pivotal role in setting the standards required to provide a service second-to-none.
• Take Ownership: Responsible for the infrastructure of the product, ensuring that it's future-proof, using new and exciting technologies and features to keep us ahead of the curve.

Requirements
• Proven experience in AWS, understanding the nuances of cloud infrastructure and its pivotal role in delivering cutting-edge solutions, with large amounts of traffic.
• Extensive knowledge on CI/CD, GDPR & Security (SOC2 Compliance) and how to implement them.
• Proven experience as a senior Laravel/PHP developer working on a medium/large SaaS product.
• A problem-solver at heart, with a keen eye for detail and a passion for clean, efficient code.
• A team player who thrives in collaborative environments, eager to share knowledge and learn from peers.
• Someone who resonates with our mission, eager to contribute to a product that's reshaping the way teams interact and build on the web.
• A professional who is always prepared for rapid response in the event of any issues, demonstrating a proactive and solution-focused approach to swiftly resolve challenges.

Benefits
• Competitive salary.
• A unique chance to shape and grow within a rapidly evolving startup.
• Flexible, remote work setting promoting work-life balance.
• Part of a supportive, innovative team culture.
• Opportunities for professional growth and development in a fast-paced environment.
• Access to the latest tools and technologies in design and development of a SaaS product.
• A role that allows you to contribute to a product revolutionizing the digital collaboration space.

Join the Atarim team as we redefine the digital collaboration landscape. We look forward to welcoming a self-driven, innovative individual who is ready to excel in a remote environment!

This offer from "Atarim" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 80% flex score

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Title: DevOps Engineer

Location: APAC – Remote, CANADA – Remote, EMEA – Remote, GLOBAL – Remote, LATAM – Remote, UNITED STATES – Remote

JobDescription:

Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making Web3 universally easy to use, access, and build on.

Working with Consensys puts you at the forefront of an evolving paradigm , transforming our society for the better. We fundamentally believe blockchain is the next generation of technology that can lay the foundation for a more just and equitable society.

Blockchain tech is just over 10 years old. Ethereum itself is still a toddler and were far from reaching our full potential. Youll get to work on the tools, infrastructure, and apps that scale these platforms to billions of users.

Youll be constantly exposed to new concepts, ideas, and frameworks from your peers, and as you work on different projects challenging you to stay at the top of your game . Youll join a network of entrepreneurs and technologists... that reaches the edge of our ecosystem . Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

What youll do

We are seeking a talented DevOps Engineer capable of managing and maintaining our cloud infrastructure across Consensys. You will assist the Technology Operations team with the day to day running of a variety of platforms, assist Security teams with hardening and securing our systems and help product teams build and deploy their software.
• Configure and manage cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP and Cloudflare.
• Manage and administer our CI/CD pipelines with Github.
• Maintain and improve our internal management systems .
• Respond to IT incidents and requests through Zendesk to ensure minimal downtime and loss.
• Enhance security infrastructure by using Okta for secure Identity management.
• Document all DevOps and infrastructure-related processes within Confluence.

Would be great if you brought this to the role
• Good knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud computing platforms.
• Experience with GitHub and understanding of version control concepts.
• Knowledge of IT ticketing systems, preferably Zendesk.
• Experience with Security and Identity management tools, preferably Okta.
• Familiarity with Confluence or equivalent documentation tools.
• Understanding of blockchain technologies and familiarity with Web3.
• Good problem-solving methods and a proactive work ethos.
• Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Strong team player with the ability to work independently when needed.
• 3+ years experience administering cloud platforms
• Certification in AWS, Azure or other Cloud platforms beneficial.

Don’t meet all the requirements? Don’t sweat it. Were passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you’ve got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environmentapply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we’re ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants will be required to submit to background checks including but not limited to employment, education and criminal record checks. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement.

Consensys is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is made available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Consensys is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself which can be found ( .

The salary range for US-based candidates only will be determined throughout the interview process depending on experience and skills.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$135,000-$210,000 USD

Sistemas- DEVOPS- hace 3 horas**Descripción**:

- Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un perfil Devops para trabajar con uno de nuestros clientes, con contratación inicial con KRELL.PERFIL DESEADO:
- Experiência en GitOps/DevOps
- Más de 3 años de experiência
- Github Actions, Ansible, Springboot
- Experiência con contenedores y orquestación de contenedores
- Administración de sistemas Linux
- Experiência con una de las principales plataformas en la nube (por ejemplo, Azure, GCP, AWS)
- Se valora la experiência con cualquiera de los siguientes: Terraform / Ansible / Helm
- Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, Openshift, etc)
- Herramientas de entrega progresiva (por ejemplo, Argo, Flux)
- Administración de PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ y/o Kafka
- FUNCIONES:
- Trabajar con el equipo de ingeniería de software para instituir, documentar y administrar un flujo de trabajo de desarrollo estándar
- Revisiones de código y automatización asociada (por ejemplo. análisis de cobertura de código)
- Gestión de... versiones y coordinación de lanzamientos
- Gestión de código fuente
- Administración de repositorios GitHub, equipos y entidades relacionadas
- Mitigación de seguridad
- Optimizar los procesos de construcción
- Crear y mantener tuberías CI/CD
- Realizar despliegues
- Estar de guardia para soporte de producción
- Mantenerse constantemente al día sobre las últimas tendencias DevOps, mejores prácticas y tecnología
- Ubicación: España, 100% teletrabajoSector: Banca
